author: Claude Code (leader) on user request 2026-09-24
question: Do the TradingView MA Ribbon SMA50/SMA200 regime lines, alone or as features/gates for a small ML model, give a net-positive BTC trading edge that survives a hidden most-recent year?

data.source: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT public REST klines 1d/4h + fundingRate, data/raw/ma_ribbon_20260924/manifest.json

splits.holdout_rule: Holdout rows are computed once, after this file is hashed. No parameter, threshold, feature, or selection change after holdout exposure. Any later variant is labelled post-holdout development.
splits.exposure_disclosure: The holdout year is NOT pristine in the human sense: earlier OpenCode/Codex rounds loaded 2022-2026 5m candles for other strategies, and the leader saw the user's TradingView chart. Protection comes only from this pre-registration and from not selecting on holdout.

execution.decision: at close of bar t using only bars <= t and funding with fundingTime <= close(t)

funding.normal: long pays 0.0001 per 8h on current notional, short 0 (AGENTS.md assumption)
funding.actual: historical Binance funding applied by sign to both sides

execution.sizing: fixed 1x of current equity at entry, compounded, initial capital 100
execution.drawdown: reported both daily-close sampled and intrabar worst (long uses bar low, short uses bar high)

primary_hypotheses.H1_cross_long: Long 1x when SMA50 > SMA200 on daily closes, else flat (user's exact lines, no tuning)
primary_hypotheses.H2_cross_long_short: Long when SMA50 > SMA200, short when SMA50 < SMA200
primary_hypotheses.H3_ribbon_long: Long when close > SMA50 and SMA50 > SMA200, else flat
primary_hypotheses.H4_ribbon_long_short: H3 plus short when close < SMA50 and SMA50 < SMA200
primary_hypotheses.H5_ml_gated: Frozen HGB classifier (spec below) fit on development only; long when p_up > 0.55 AND SMA50 > SMA200; short when p_up < 0.45 AND SMA50 < SMA200; else flat
primary_hypotheses.benchmark: Buy and hold 1x long with the same fees/funding

secondary_grid.constraint: fast < slow; 4h periods are counted in 4h bars
secondary_grid.selection_on_development_only: maximize development annualized Sharpe of daily net returns (normal costs) subject to >= 8 development trades and development intrabar max DD <= 0.45; exactly one selected config is then evaluated once on holdout; the full grid holdout table is reported for context only

ml_spec.features: log(close/SMA k) k in 20,50,100,200; log(SMA50/SMA200); SMA50 10d slope; SMA200 20d slope; log returns 1,3,7,14,30,60,90d; realized vol 14d,30d and their ratio; 60d range position; funding mean 7d,30d; log volume z-score 30d; taker-buy ratio 7d
ml_spec.label: sign of log(open[t+11]/open[t+1]) (10-day forward return from next open)
ml_spec.development_evaluation: expanding walk-forward inside development, first fit on labels ending before 2021-01-01, refit every 90 days, 10-day embargo between last label end and first prediction

holdout_evaluation.frozen: single fit on all development labels ending before 2025-09-24 (primary)
holdout_evaluation.walk_forward: continue 90-day refits using only labels already realized (secondary)

report: block bootstrap 20d CI of holdout daily mean and of excess vs buy-and-hold

acceptance.research_candidate: holdout net > 0 under normal AND stress costs, holdout intrabar DD <= 0.20, and development net > buy-and-hold on a risk-adjusted basis (Sharpe)
acceptance.aspiration: 3% monthly is reported, not required; no return is guaranteed
acceptance.statistical_caveat: slow MA rules trade a few times per year; one holdout year cannot establish significance
acceptance.not_authorized: live orders, exchange credentials, leverage above 1x
